title: Magnet for dirt
text: Magnet for dirt. My biggest complaint is that these are a magnet for dirt. I didn't even think about that when I bought them, but I guess that's how silicone is. So, they won't work to carry around in my bag for use on the go. They seem to work alright otherwise, however.
